title: Frequency-Response Interpretation of a One-Quarter-Car Suspension Design
expert_review: A comprehensive frequency-domain interpretation of a realistic quarter-car suspension model with clear links between pole locations and ride dynamics.
learning_objectives: Interpret suspension design results using frequency-response methods
Relate dominant pole locations to Bode plot features
Analyze high-order mechanical systems in the frequency domain
Validate suspension performance objectives using resonance analysis
Understand the role of unsprung mass in vehicle dynamics
